name: CodeI Lab
description: CodeI Lab is an independent third-party GPT API gateway for coding agents (not affiliated with OpenAI). One API key calls GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 models through the OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API or the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and OpenCode work unchanged (OpenAI-compatible base URL https://www.codeilab.com/api/codex). Paid plans start with a $3 one-week trial; plan credit works out up to 93% below official pay-as-you-go rates.
